name: Berzocana (Spain)
description: Red field with a broad border charged with eight yellow saltires enclosing a green rectangle, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Berzocana (a castle and a cross on green and red).
history: Municipal flag of Berzocana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad border with eight yellow saltires
